versions.changelog: Add Taobao baseline bridge, evidence gate, and expanded proxy evals.
P1: reposition as Taobao price comparison and standardize shopping safety boundaries.
Add category-aware buying playbooks, preference routing, platform-fit gates, category-specific price thresholds, and proxy eval cases.
Add Taobao baseline handling, 100-point match scoring, normalized price comparison, evidence gates, and recommendation strength.
Add matrix cross-sell guidance to route users to the right shopping skill.
Improve install-page positioning, add stronger trigger language, and clarify shopping decision output.
Upgrade from price table output to buying recommendation and seller-risk comparison workflow.
Initial release with browser-only competitor price analysis across JD, Pinduoduo, and Vipshop.
